description: This Swift source file defines a singleton class CanvasManager responsible for managing a canvas panel in a macOS application. It handles creation, display, hiding, evaluation, and snapshotting of the canvas. Additionally, it manages gateway observation for auto-navigation to specific URLs, and provides anchoring and URL resolution helpers.

classes.name: CanvasManager
classes.description: A singleton class managing the lifecycle and interactions of a canvas panel in a macOS app, including showing, hiding, evaluating JavaScript, and observing gateway updates.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the canvas with a specific session key and optional path and placement, reusing existing sessions if possible.

methods.name: showDetailed
methods.description: Displays the canvas with detailed parameters including session key, target path, and placement. Loads the canvas content accordingly.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the canvas session associated with the provided session key.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript string in the context of the current canvas session asynchronously.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the current canvas view asynchronously and saves it to a specified path.

methods.name: refreshDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status UI elements based on current app state and connection mode.
